name: quran-audio
title: Quran Audio
description:
This extension allows users to:
- Browse Surahs
- Select reciters
- Play full Surah audio
- Stop playback
- Continue listening in background even after Raycast closes

Future versions will support:
- Verse-level playback
- Looping verses for memorization
- Offline caching
author: abdullahnettoor

commands.name: set-default-reciter
commands.title: Set Default Reciter
commands.description: Choose your preferred reciter for one-click playback

commands.name: playing-status
commands.title: Playing Status
commands.description: Show currently playing Surah in Menu Bar

preferences.name: defaultReciterId
preferences.title: Default Reciter ID
preferences.description: The ID of the default reciter (set via 'Set Default Reciter' command)

preferences.name: defaultReciterName
preferences.title: Default Reciter Name
preferences.description: The name of the default reciter

" && exit 1
